paragraphs: A new Irish website wants to help people buy healthy puppies. It is called DogQuest. Two men, Kevin Moore and Brian Ivess, started it about two years ago.
Ireland has a bad name for puppy farms. Some breeders keep too many dogs in poor conditions. Buyers often cannot check if a puppy is healthy.
On DogQuest, vets can check each puppy. Then the vet gives a special code. A green tick shows the puppy has had its vaccines. A gold star shows it had a health check.
Buyers can also see the puppy's family and write reviews of sellers. About 70 vet clinics already work with the site.
The site is free for buyers, sellers and vets. The two men spent about €20,000 to build it. They hope to make money later.

愛爾蘭的幼犬繁殖場名聲很差。
有些繁殖者在惡劣的環境中飼養太多狗。
買家常常無法確認小狗是否健康。
在 DogQuest 上，獸醫可以檢查每一隻小狗。
接著獸醫會給一組特別的代碼。
綠色勾號表示小狗已經打過疫苗。
金色星號表示牠做過健康檢查。
買家也能看到小狗的家族資料，並為賣家寫評價。
大約70家獸醫診所已經和這個網站合作。
這個網站對買家、賣家和獸醫都是免費的。
這兩人花了大約兩萬歐元打造它。
他們希望以後能賺錢。

paragraphs: An Irish start-up called DogQuest wants to stop bad breeders from selling sick puppies. The online marketplace was set up by Kevin Moore and Brian Ivess, and it took about two years to build.

Ireland is sometimes called the puppy farming capital of Europe. Many buyers have no way to check what a seller says about a puppy's vaccines or health. The founders say ordinary advertising websites simply let sellers tick a box.

DogQuest is different because vets are part of the process. A vet who checks a puppy gives the seller a unique code. Ads with a checked vaccine show a green tick, and ads with a checked health test show a gold star. Buyers can also see the puppy's family tree and the mother's microchip number, and they can leave reviews of sellers.
The founders say they have already worked with about 70 vet practices around the country. There is also a section that asks buyers about their lifestyle and suggests breeds that would suit them.

Moore and Ivess put about €20,000 of their own money into the project and got help from their local enterprise office in Limerick. For now the site is free for everyone. They hope to make money later, when more people use it.
sentZh: 一家名叫 DogQuest 的愛爾蘭新創公司想阻止不良繁殖者販賣生病的小狗。
這個線上交易平台由凱文·摩爾和布萊恩·艾維斯創立，花了大約兩年時間才建好。
愛爾蘭有時被稱為「歐洲的幼犬繁殖場之都」。
許多買家沒有辦法查證賣家對小狗疫苗或健康狀況的說法。
創辦人說，一般的廣告網站只是讓賣家自己打勾。
DogQuest 不一樣的地方在於獸醫參與了整個流程。
檢查過小狗的獸醫會給賣家一組獨一無二的代碼。
疫苗經過確認的廣告會顯示綠色勾號，健康檢查經過確認的廣告則顯示金色星號。
買家還能看到小狗的家譜和狗媽媽的晶片號碼，也可以為賣家留下評價。
創辦人說，他們已經和全國約70家獸醫診所合作過。
網站還有一個單元會詢問買家的生活方式，並推薦適合他們的犬種。
摩爾和艾維斯自掏腰包約兩萬歐元投入這個計畫，並獲得利默里克地方企業辦公室的協助。
目前這個網站對所有人免費。
他們希望等使用的人變多之後再開始賺錢。

paragraphs: DogQuest, a new Irish online marketplace for puppies, aims to tackle irresponsible breeding by giving buyers reliable information about the animals they are considering. It was founded by Kevin Moore and Brian Ivess, who spent around two years developing the platform.

Ireland has long had a poor reputation as the 'puppy farming capital of Europe'. According to Moore, buyers currently have no means of verifying claims about vaccinations or health checks, since most classified-ad websites rely on sellers ticking boxes themselves.

The key difference is the involvement of vets. When a participating vet examines a puppy, they issue a unique verification code. Listings with a confirmed vaccination display a green tick, while those with a confirmed health check carry a gold star. Each listing also includes a family tree and the mother's microchip number, and buyers can review sellers. The founders believe this traceability could expose breeders who produce litters repeatedly.

So far, about 70 veterinary practices across the country have worked with the company, and Moore says the response has been very positive. A 'Start Your Journey' section asks potential owners about their lifestyle and recommends suitable breeds.

The founders invested about €20,000 and received support from the Limerick local enterprise office, including a digital voucher. The service is free for buyers, sellers and vets, and the pair do not expect revenue until the site attracts enough users.
sentZh: DogQuest 是愛爾蘭新的線上幼犬交易平台，目標是提供買家關於他們考慮購買的動物的可靠資訊，以解決不負責任的繁殖問題。
它由凱文·摩爾和布萊恩·艾維斯創立，兩人花了約兩年開發這個平台。
愛爾蘭長久以來背負著「歐洲幼犬繁殖場之都」的壞名聲。
摩爾表示，買家目前無法查證關於疫苗接種或健康檢查的說法，因為大多數分類廣告網站都只靠賣家自己打勾。
關鍵的差別在於獸醫的參與。
當參與合作的獸醫檢查一隻小狗時，會核發一組獨一無二的驗證碼。
疫苗接種經過確認的刊登會顯示綠色勾號，健康檢查經過確認的則會有金色星號。
每則刊登也附有家譜和狗媽媽的晶片號碼，買家還可以評價賣家。
創辦人相信，這種可追溯性能揭露反覆讓母犬生產的繁殖者。
到目前為止，全國約有70家獸醫診所與這家公司合作，摩爾說反應非常正面。
「開始你的旅程」單元會詢問潛在飼主的生活方式，並推薦合適的犬種。
創辦人投資了約兩萬歐元，並獲得利默里克地方企業辦公室的支持，包括一張數位化補助券。
這項服務對買家、賣家和獸醫都免費，兩人預計要等網站吸引到足夠的使用者後才會有收入。

paragraphs: An Irish start-up is attempting to clean up the country's murky puppy trade. DogQuest, an online marketplace established by Kevin Moore and Brian Ivess, seeks to stamp out irresponsible breeding by furnishing prospective owners with trustworthy, vet-verified information.

Ireland has acquired the unenviable label of 'puppy farming capital of Europe'. Moore contends that buyers are presently unable to substantiate sellers' assertions about vaccinations or health checks, because conventional classified-ad sites depend entirely on self-declaration.

The platform's distinguishing feature is the role played by vets. Participating practitioners issue a unique verification code once they have vaccinated or examined a puppy. Verified listings are flagged with a green tick for vaccinations and a gold star for health checks, and each advert discloses the litter's pedigree and the mother's microchip number. Sellers can be reviewed, and the founders argue that such traceability may expose breeders who churn out litter after litter.
Roughly 70 veterinary practices nationwide have already come on board, and Moore describes their reaction as overwhelmingly favourable.

The venture was bootstrapped with about €20,000 of the founders' own funds, supplemented by backing from the Limerick local enterprise office. It remains free of charge for all users, and the pair anticipate no revenue until it reaches critical mass, after which they may explore commercial opportunities and other markets.
sentZh: 一家愛爾蘭新創公司正試圖整頓國內混亂不透明的幼犬買賣。

愛爾蘭背上了「歐洲幼犬繁殖場之都」這個不光彩的標籤。
摩爾主張，買家目前無法證實賣家對疫苗接種或健康檢查的說法，因為傳統的分類廣告網站完全仰賴自我申報。
這個平台的特色在於獸醫所扮演的角色。
參與的獸醫在為小狗接種疫苗或檢查後，會核發一組獨特的驗證碼。
經過驗證的刊登會以綠色勾號標示疫苗接種、以金色星號標示健康檢查，每則廣告也會公開這窩小狗的血統和狗媽媽的晶片號碼。
賣家可以被評價，創辦人認為這種可追溯性或許能揭發一窩接一窩大量繁殖的業者。
全國已有大約70家獸醫診所加入，摩爾形容他們的反應極為正面。
這項事業以創辦人自有資金約兩萬歐元起步，並輔以利默里克地方企業辦公室的支持。
它對所有使用者仍然免費，兩人預期在達到臨界規模之前不會有收入，之後才可能探索商業機會和其他市場。

paragraphs: DogQuest, a recently launched Irish online marketplace, represents a deliberate attempt to address the persistent problem of irresponsible dog breeding. Founded by Kevin Moore and Brian Ivess, the platform is designed to provide prospective owners with transparent and verifiable information prior to purchase.

The initiative responds to Ireland's widely criticised reputation as the 'puppy farming capital of Europe'. Moore maintains that, under existing arrangements, buyers have virtually no means of validating claims regarding vaccinations or health checks, since conventional advertising sites are essentially contingent upon sellers' own declarations.

Consequently, the platform's central mechanism is the integration of veterinary verification. Participating vets generate a unique code following vaccination or examination, and verified listings subsequently display a green tick or a gold star respectively. Furthermore, each listing documents the puppy's lineage and the mother's microchip number, while seller reviews and the resulting traceability may reveal patterns of repeated breeding.

Approximately 70 veterinary practices have participated to date, and the response has reportedly been highly positive. In addition, a dedicated section evaluates prospective owners' lifestyles in order to recommend appropriate breeds.

Financially, the project was initiated with a modest investment of approximately €20,000, complemented by support from a local enterprise office. Nevertheless, the service currently generates no revenue; monetisation is contingent upon attracting a substantial user base.

這個平台由凱文·摩爾和布萊恩·艾維斯創立，旨在讓未來的飼主在購買之前取得透明且可查證的資訊。
這項計畫是針對愛爾蘭飽受批評的「歐洲幼犬繁殖場之都」名聲而提出的。
摩爾堅稱，在現行的安排下，買家幾乎無法驗證有關疫苗接種或健康檢查的說法，因為傳統廣告網站基本上完全取決於賣家自己的聲明。
因此，這個平台的核心機制是整合獸醫認證。
參與的獸醫在接種疫苗或檢查後會產生一組獨特的代碼，經過驗證的刊登隨後會分別顯示綠色勾號或金色星號。
此外，每則刊登都記錄了小狗的血統和狗媽媽的晶片號碼，而賣家評價及由此產生的可追溯性則可能揭露重複繁殖的模式。
迄今約有70家獸醫診所參與，據報反應非常正面。
此外，一個專門的單元會評估未來飼主的生活方式，以便推薦合適的犬種。
在財務方面，這個計畫以約兩萬歐元的少量投資起步，並輔以地方企業辦公室的支持。
然而，這項服務目前沒有任何收入；能否獲利取決於能否吸引大量的使用者。
